source_metadata.title: Silica Coating Reduces Capacity Fade in LiNiO2 Cathodes

assertions.assertion: Silica coating decreases capacity fade in LiNiO2 cathodes after 100 cycles.

evidence.quote: The uncoated cell retained 71% capacity after 100 cycles. ... The coated cell retained 88% capacity under the same conditions.

limitations: One coated and one uncoated cell were compared.

assertions.assertion: After 100 cycles, the silica-coated cell retains more capacity than the uncoated cell.

evidence.quote: The uncoated cell retained 71% capacity after 100 cycles. ... The coated cell retained 88% capacity under the same conditions.

assertions.assertion: The test cells used a lithium metal anode.

evidence.quote: Cells used a lithium metal anode and 1 M LiPF6 electrolyte.

assertions.assertion: Silica coating is associated with suppressed surface reconstruction.

evidence.quote: the coating may suppress surface reconstruction

limitations: Post-mortem evidence is limited and the mechanism is not proven.

unresolved.reason: The paper states that coating thickness was not measured after cycling.
unresolved.action: Do not assert a thickness-dependent mechanism; keep the claim as an open question.
